english.title: With intent to deceive forge / use a document issued / required for a purpose under an environmental permit condition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive

(A)_[forged]_
(B)_[used]_

a document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..),

(C)_[issued]_
(D)_[authorised to be issued]_
(E)_[required]_

for a purpose under an environmental permit condition
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 38(4)(d)(i) and 39(3) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010.

(A)_[ffugio]_
(B)_[ddefnyddio]_

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit or Prosecutions:
None.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
